# axcl.pool

## 1. Index

- [axcl.pool.set_config](#axcl.pool.set_config): Set the common pool floorplan of the media subsystem.
- [axcl.pool.get_config](#axcl.pool.get_config): Get the common pool floorplan of the media subsystem.
- [axcl.pool.init](#axcl.pool.init): Create common pools according to the configured floorplan.
- [axcl.pool.exit](#axcl.pool.exit): Release all created media subsystem pools.
- [axcl.pool.create_pool](#axcl.pool.create_pool): Create a video buffer pool.
- [axcl.pool.destroy_pool](#axcl.pool.destroy_pool): Destroy a video buffer pool created by AX_POOL_CreatePool.
- [axcl.pool.get_block](#axcl.pool.get_block): Get a block from a specified pool or a matching common pool.
- [axcl.pool.release_block](#axcl.pool.release_block): Release a block borrowed by AX_POOL_GetBlock.
- [axcl.pool.phy_addr_to_handle](#axcl.pool.phy_addr_to_handle): Convert a pool block physical address to a block ID.
- [axcl.pool.handle_to_phy_addr](#axcl.pool.handle_to_phy_addr): Convert a block ID to the block physical address.
- [axcl.pool.handle_to_meta_phys_addr](#axcl.pool.handle_to_meta_phys_addr): Convert a block ID to the metadata physical address.
- [axcl.pool.handle_to_pool_id](#axcl.pool.handle_to_pool_id): Get the pool ID that owns a block ID.
- [axcl.pool.handle_to_blk_size](#axcl.pool.handle_to_blk_size): Get the aligned block size of a block ID.
- [axcl.pool.mmap_pool](#axcl.pool.mmap_pool): Map all block memory of a video buffer pool to user virtual addresses.
- [axcl.pool.munmap_pool](#axcl.pool.munmap_pool): Unmap user virtual addresses of a video buffer pool.
- [axcl.pool.get_block_vir_addr](#axcl.pool.get_block_vir_addr): Get the user virtual address of a pool block.
- [axcl.pool.get_meta_vir_addr](#axcl.pool.get_meta_vir_addr): Get the user virtual address of a pool block metadata area.
- [axcl.pool.increase_ref_cnt](#axcl.pool.increase_ref_cnt): Increase the AX_ID_USER reference count of a pool block.
- [axcl.pool.decrease_ref_cnt](#axcl.pool.decrease_ref_cnt): Decrease the AX_ID_USER reference count of a pool block.
- [axcl.pool.free_comm_pool](#axcl.pool.free_comm_pool): Release only common pool memory.

<a id="axcl.pool.set_config"></a>

### 2.1. axcl.pool.set_config

Set the common pool floorplan of the media subsystem.

#### 2.1.1. Function

**Python Call**

```python
ret = axcl.pool.set_config(pool_floor_plan)
```

**C++ Prototype**

```cpp
AX_S32 AX_POOL_SetConfig(const AX_POOL_FLOORPLAN_T *pPoolFloorPlan);
```

#### 2.1.2. Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| pool_floor_plan | dict &#124; None | Pointer to the common pool floorplan. |

#### 2.1.3. Returns

- `ret`: *int* — Success. Failure; returns a POOL error code.

#### 2.1.4. Note

Return type: `int`.

#### 2.1.5. Example

```python
ret = axcl.pool.set_config(pool_floor_plan)
```

### 2.7. axcl.pool.get_block

Get a block from a specified pool or a matching common pool.

#### 2.7.1. Function

**Python Call**

```python
ret = axcl.pool.get_block(pool_id, blk_size, partition_name)
```

**C++ Prototype**

```cpp
AX_BLK AX_POOL_GetBlock(AX_POOL PoolId, AX_U64 BlkSize, const AX_S8 *pPartitionName);
```

#### 2.7.2. Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| pool_id | int | Pool ID. Use |
| blk_size | int | Requested block size in bytes. |
| partition_name | str &#124; bytes &#124; None | CMM partition name for common-pool lookup. If NULL, use the anonymous partition. |

#### 2.7.3. Returns

- `ret`: *int* — Valid block ID if success;

#### 2.7.4. Note

Return type: `int`.

#### 2.7.5. Example

```python
ret = axcl.pool.get_block(pool_id, blk_size, partition_name)
```
